prompt: Write a one-star review of the Statue of Liberty from a reviewer who is upset that you have to take a boat.
response: I’m honestly baffled by the hype. No one warned me that you have to get on a BOAT to see this thing. I thought it was just in a park somewhere in Manhattan. You can’t walk there, you can’t drive there, you can’t Uber there—you have to subject yourself to a full maritime expedition. I didn’t sign up for a nautical journey; I just wanted to see a statue. If I wanted a boat ride, I’d have joined the Navy. Total logistical nightmare. One star. Put a bridge in.
